newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends unchanged against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends unchanged against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed unchanged at 8.3053 against the U.S dollar on Thursday on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, with the central bank selling the local currency, traders said.

The yuan hit a high of 8.3041 in intra-day trading, the highest level in the past year, due to strong pro-yuan sentiment but failed to close high due to intervention by the People's Bank of China, they said.
"The central bank kept intervening to depress the yuan this week," said a trader. "Had there been no intervention, the yuan would have risen sharply due to strong pro-yuan sentiment."
The yuan opened slightly up at 8.3051 today and moved around 8.3052 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day low of 8.3065 twice and a high of 8.3041 in late trading.
Trading was dull, with most done at about 8.3052.
Traders expect the yuan to consolidate around the 8.3050 level on Friday.
The yuan closed up at 7.5241 from 7.5480 against 100 Japanese yen and unchanged at an intra-day low of 1.0750 against the Hong Kong dollar.
